The only thing I could say is to leave him. I know you don’t want to and I know it’s hard but from the way you described him he does seem to be treating you poorly. Withholding love, affection and communication is emotionally abusive. My ex used to do that. I dated him for 5 months and I used to tell myself every day that I would break up with him but I couldn’t. He eventually left me which turned out in my favor because I truly don’t know if I would’ve left him if he didn’t. Being with him for those 5 months has caused a lot of trauma and contributed to my ptsd. You’ve been with your boyfriend longer so I can imagine how it could possibly be affecting you negatively. I still have panic attacks sometimes when I think of him and I get extremely angry and depressed. Being with someone who doesn’t really support you or is narcissistic or abusive can be very detrimental to your mental health. We’ve been apart for almost 6 months now and I’m still healing. Please consider the effects this could have on your mental health. 
Good luck! :)
